newsitem.title: USA: Old Dominion names David Congdon president.
newsitem.headline: Old Dominion names David Congdon president.

text.p: Old Dominion Freight Line Inc said Monday its board promoted David Congdon to president and chief operating officer of the company.
Congdon, former vice president-quality and field services, succeeds John Ebeling, who has been elected vice chairman of the board, it said.

Old Dominion also announced the promotion of John Yowell to executive vice president, J. Wes Frye to senior vice president-finance and chief financial officer, Joel McCarty to senior vice president and general counsel, and J. Timothy Turner to senior vice president-sales and marketing.
